markdown.markdown: curriculum vitae **Senior Technical Lead – Statistical Programming · Clinical Data Scientist · PhD Candidate** 📍 Trivandrum, Kerala, India · ✉️ [imaheshdivakaran@gmail.com](mailto:imaheshdivakaran@gmail.com) · [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/imaheshdivakaran/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/itsmdivakaran) --- ## Professional Summary Senior Technical Lead (Statistical Programming) and Clinical Data Scientist with **close to a decade (9+ years)** of experience in clinical data analysis, CDISC standards (SDTM, ADaM), and TLG/TFL generation. Currently a PhD candidate in Statistics at Amity University. Expert in **R, SAS, and Python** with a strong track record of building R packages, automating clinical reporting pipelines, and developing R Shiny dashboards for data visualization. International conference presenter (PHUSE US & EU), SAS Certified Base Programmer, and part-time Biostatistics lecturer. Experienced in regulatory submissions (FDA XML outputs) and cross-functional team leadership. --- ## Core Competencies R Programming (Advanced) SAS Base / Macros / STAT Python SDTM & ADaM Programming TLG / TFL Generation CDISC Standards FDA Regulatory Submissions R Package Development R Shiny Dashboard Development Tableau & Power BI Statistical Analysis Plan (SAP) Biostatistics Machine Learning NLP / NER Team Leadership & Mentoring --- ## Professional Experience ::: {.cv-role} [**Senior Technical Lead – Statistical Programming**]{.role-title} [[Ephicacy Lifescience Analytics](https://www.linkedin.com/company/ephicacy-lifescience-analytics/) · Full-time · Trivandrum, Kerala, India (Remote)]{.role-company} [March 2026 – Present]{.role-date} - Lead statistical programming deliverables for clinical trials, ensuring CDISC (SDTM/ADaM) and regulatory compliance - Drive R-based automation of clinical reporting workflows and mentor programming teams ::: ::: {.cv-role} [**Senior Statistical Programmer**]{.role-title} [IQVIA RDS Pvt. Ltd. · India]{.role-company} [July 2024 – March 2026]{.role-date} - Lead R package development and validation activities for clinical trial reporting workflows - Maintain and expand an R package catalogue documenting packages used across clinical studies to ensure reproducibility and compliance - Drive TLG (Tables, Listings, Graphs) generation using validated R packages in line with CDISC and regulatory standards ::: ::: {.cv-role} [**Associate Lead – Clinical Data Analytics**]{.role-title} [Genpro Research Pvt. Ltd. · Trivandrum, Kerala, India]{.role-company} [April 2023 – July 2024]{.role-date} - Led development of R Shiny dashboards for clinical data visualization and TFL reporting automation, reducing manual effort significantly - Architected and maintained R packages for end-to-end automation of SDTM, ADaM, and TFL creation, improving team throughput and consistency - Mentored and trained a team of analysts in open-source clinical reporting tools, building in-house R capabilities - Created R-based standard scripts to generate ADaM datasets and produce listings, tables, and graphs - Developed SAS programs for clinical summaries and listings in compliance with CDISC standards ::: ::: {.cv-role} [**Data Analyst Level II**]{.role-title} [Genpro Research Pvt. Ltd. · Trivandrum, Kerala, India]{.role-company} [April 2022 – March 2023]{.role-date} - Developed R Shiny dashboards for clinical data visualization and interactive trial reporting - Built R packages to automate ADaM dataset generation and SAS date conversion within R environments - Produced SAS programs for clinical data summaries and listings - Created R Markdown-based documentation and catalogues for R scripts ::: ::: {.cv-role} [**Statistical Programmer Level I**]{.role-title} [Genpro Research Pvt. Ltd. · Trivandrum, Kerala, India]{.role-company} [September 2019 – March 2022]{.role-date} - Converted clinical study datasets to CDISC/SDTM standards across multiple therapeutic areas including Phlebotomy and Gastroenterology - Developed SAS macro programs for ADaM dataset generation and TFL creation - Programmed multiple SDTM domains and authored patient narratives for clinical study reports - Generated XML outputs for FDA regulatory submissions - Conducted COVID-19 and medical prescription data analyses using R, applying Lasso and Ridge Regression statistical models ::: ::: {.cv-role} [**Data Scientist**]{.role-title} [Menerva Software · Cochin, Kerala, India]{.role-company} [February 2019 – November 2019]{.role-date} - Developed Medical Entity Recognition (Bio-NER) models for insurance data processing - Performed customer and promotion analysis for a large coffee chain using advanced statistical techniques - Researched cryptocurrency value forecasting for Ethereum tokens using time-series models ::: ::: {.cv-role} [**Data Scientist / ML Developer**]{.role-title} [Suyati Technologies · Cochin, Kerala, India]{.role-company} [June 2018 – January 2019]{.role-date} - Developed machine learning models for Pricing Intelligence, Sales Forecasting, and Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV) prediction - Delivered a webinar on 'Buy Till You Die model for CLTV' to industry professionals ::: ::: {.cv-role} [**Business Analyst**]{.role-title} [BRIDGEi2i Analytics Solutions Pvt. Ltd. · Bangalore, India]{.role-company} [May 2017 – May 2018]{.role-date} - Performed Tweet Sentiment Analysis using NLP techniques - Contributed to Chatbot development using NLU frameworks - Built regression and classification models and developed dynamic pricing models ::: --- ## Teaching Experience ::: {.cv-role} [**Part-Time Lecturer in Biostatistics**]{.role-title} [Gulf Medical University · UAE (Remote)]{.role-company} [January 2022 – August 2023]{.role-date} - Taught Biostatistics to medical students, covering descriptive statistics, inferential methods, clinical trial design, and data interpretation ::: --- ## Technical Skills **Statistical Programming** R (Advanced) · Python (Advanced) · SAS Base SAS · SAS Macros · SAS/STAT (Certified) **Clinical Standards** SDTM · ADaM · CDISC Standards · TLG/TFL Programming · CSR & SAP Automation · Define.xml · FDA XML Submissions **Pharmaverse Tools** admiral · sdtm.oak · xportr · metacore · tlg · rtables **R Ecosystem** R Shiny · R Package Development · R Markdown · ggplot2 · tidyverse (dplyr, tidyr) · Plotly · survival · caret **Python Ecosystem** pandas · NumPy · Matplotlib · scikit-learn · TensorFlow / PyTorch **Machine Learning & AI** Supervised & Unsupervised Learning · CNNs · RNNs · NER · Text Classification · Generative AI · CLTV Models **Data Visualization** R Shiny · ggplot2 · Plotly · Matplotlib · Tableau · Power BI **Statistical Methods** Survival Analysis · Mixed Models · ANOVA · Logistic Regression · Epidemiological Modelling **Version Control & Productivity** Git · GitHub · Microsoft Office · LaTeX --- ## Education | Degree | Institution | Year | |--------|-------------|------| | PhD in Statistics *(In Progress)* | Amity University, Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh | 2024–Present | | Diploma in Project Management | Oxford Home Study Center (OHSC), Oxford, UK | 2023 | | M.Sc. in Statistics | Cochin University of Science and Technology, Kerala | 2015–2017 | | B.Sc. in Statistics | Christian College, Kattakada, University of Kerala | 2012–2015 | --- ## Professional Certifications ::: {.cert-item} **SAS Certified Base Programmer** · SAS Institute · 2021 ::: ::: {.cert-item} **IBM Data Science Professional Certification** · IBM · 2020 ::: ::: {.cert-item} **Data Science Specialization (R)** · Johns Hopkins University / Coursera · 2022 ::: ::: {.cert-item} **Google Data Analytics Professional Certification (R)** · Google · 2023 ::: ::: {.cert-item} **Google Project Management Professional Certification** · Google · 2024 ::: ::: {.cert-item} **Career Essentials in Data Analysis** · Microsoft & LinkedIn · 2023 ::: ::: {.cert-item} **SDTM001: Introduction to Study Data Tabulation Model** · CDISC ::: --- ## Open-Source Software (Public Domain) **R Packages on CRAN** | Package | Description | Role | Year | |---------|-------------|------|------| | [EasyStat](https://cran.r-project.org/package=EasyStat) | Automated Statistical Analysis, Visualization and Multi-Format Narrative Reporting | Maintainer | 2026 | | [RenyiExtropy](https://cran.r-project.org/package=RenyiExtropy) | Entropy and Extropy Measures for Probability Distributions | Maintainer | 2026 | | [BivLaplaceRL](https://cran.r-project.org/package=BivLaplaceRL) | Bivariate Laplace Transforms, Stochastic Orders, and Entropy Measures in Reliability | Maintainer | 2026 | | [ViewR](https://cran.r-project.org/package=ViewR) | Interactive Data Viewer, Filter, and Editor | Maintainer | 2026 | | [pharmaverseadamjnj](https://cran.r-project.org/package=pharmaverseadamjnj) | J&J Innovative Medicine ADaM Test Data | Contributor | 2025 | | [SASdates](https://cran.r-project.org/package=SASdates) | Convert the Dates to 'SAS' Formats | Maintainer | 2022 | **Python Packages on PyPI** | Package | Description | Role | |---------|-------------|------| | [viewdt](https://pypi.org/project/viewdt/) | Interactive data viewer for Python | Maintainer | --- ## Peer-Reviewed Publications & Conference Proceedings ::: {.pub-item} **Automation of ADaM Dataset & TFL Visualization through an R Package – GenAdam2** Divakaran, M. & Mohanan, M. K. (2023). *PHUSE US Connect 2023 Conference Proceedings.* Orlando, USA. ::: ::: {.pub-item} **Automation of Standard ADaM Variables Through an R Package – GenAdam** Divakaran, M. & Mohanan, M. K. (2022). *PHUSE EU Connect 2022 Conference Proceedings.* Belfast, UK. ::: ::: {.pub-item} **Clinical Design – Visualization and Analysis using the Interactive Application by R Shiny** Divakaran, M. & Sudhakar, A. DOI: [10.13140/RG.2.2.26715.39201](https://doi.org/10.13140/RG.2.2.26715.39201) ::: --- ## Conference Presentations & Attendance | Conference | Location | Year | |------------|----------|------| | PHUSE US Connect 2023 | Orlando, USA | March 5–8, 2023 | | PHUSE EU Connect 2022 | Belfast, United Kingdom | November 13–16, 2022 | | PHUSE EU Connect 2021 | London, United Kingdom | November 13–16, 2021 | | PSI Conference 2021 | Virtual | October 21–23, 2021 | | ISPS Conference 2016 | Aligarh, Uttar Pradesh | December 17–19, 2016 | --- ## Professional Affiliations & Volunteering Volunteer – CDISC Open-Source Alliance (COSA) Volunteer – Kerala Police Cyberdome Life Member – Indian Society for Probability and Statistics (ISPS) --- ## Honours & Awards - **Quarterly Employee Award** · Genpro Research - **NCC B Certificate** · NCC India --- ## Connect with Me [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/LinkedIn-0077B5?style=for-the-badge&logo=linkedin&logoColor=white)](https://www.linkedin.com/in/imaheshdivakaran/) [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub-181717?style=for-the-badge&logo=github&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/itsmdivakaran) [![](https://img.shields.io/badge/Email-D13832?style=for-the-badge&logo=gmail&logoColor=white)](mailto:imaheshdivakaran@gmail.com)
